$comment: Declarative record of every approved content release promoted into the publication directory, per project-workflow.md v1.0 steps 3 and 4. scripts/import-content.mjs applies only the mechanical transformations listed in section 8.1 of that workflow and in the release record; it cannot reword, reorder, or remove prose. The approved source now carries its own complete frontmatter matching page-template.md v1.4, so metadata is passed through rather than injected here — `expect` only asserts that the promoted file is the release that was approved. `npm run check:generated` re-runs the import and fails if a publication copy has been edited by hand.

$notes.route: The approved slug moves this page from /foundation/before-you-launch/ to /before-you-launch/. navigation_group stays Foundation, so it still appears as Section 0 in the Foundation group; only the URL is top-level.
$notes.deferredLinks: Sections 1 and 2 are not approved for publication. Their canonical routes are preserved here and registered as unpublished in src/data/section-registry.json, so scripts/check-links.mjs reports them as deferred rather than broken. No placeholder page is created.
$notes.frontmatter: Passed through verbatim from the approved source. Only blank lines inserted in transport are removed; no field name or value is altered.
